headline: Patent pending. Production started November 6. Nearly every part for the batch is in the shop; the motors and the custom wheels are the last two still on their way.

stages.title: Parts in
stages.note: Nearly every part for the batch is in the shop. Two items are still coming: the motors, which are in production at the factory with a third-party inspection before they ship, and the custom balloon wheels and tires, whose mold is being made now.

stages.title: In production
stages.note: Production started November 6. The first frame is on the table at the fabrication shop. Every cart is built by John in slot order - same hands that built the original cart. Each one gets a serial number and a recorded test before it leaves.

stages.title: Deposits paused
stages.note: New deposits are paused while pricing is updated. Existing deposits are unchanged: each holds its numbered build slot and stays fully refundable until you approve your final invoice.

stages.title: Delivering
stages.note: Hand-delivered by John, Maine to New Jersey, in build-slot order.

footnote: This page is updated when something real happens, and only then.
